A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''keyboardist''' was part of a [[Unidentified Human band|band]] with six fellow [[Human/Legends|Humans]] in the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the band enjoyed great popularity on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="SWHS" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Human keyboardist appeared in ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', a TV movie set in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] that aired in [[1978]]. He was played by [[David Freiberg]], the real-life keyboardist of [[Jefferson Starship]], a rock band of the 70's who portrayed a fictional band in the ''Holiday Special''.<ref name="SWHS" />
